title: Enchant Limiter
body:
## **Full control over every enchantment.**

EnchantLimiter lets you cap or fully disable any enchantment in the game, per level. Whether you want to ban Protection IV in PvP, cap Sharpness at III for balance. EnchantLimiter handles it all with a single config edit or a click in the GUI.

In-game GUI via `/enchantlimiter` or `/el` with live toggling — no restart needed.

Features:

- Individual cap or full disable for every enchantment in the game
- Blocks enchanted books, gear, villager trades, anvil combines, and loot — no bypasses
- `/enchantlimiter reload` to apply config changes instantly
- Command for eaiser use `/enchantlimiter set <enchantment> <level>`
**No need to touch config.yml** — just run `/enchantlimiter` or `/el` and cap/disable enchantments directly from the menu, using the arrows to flip between pages (you can still edit the config manually if you prefer).

## Installation

1. Drop the latest `enchantlimiter-x.x.x.jar` into your `plugins/` folder.
